title: Where should "free AI lessons" send people?
detail: Thursday (reel, carousel, LinkedIn) and Sunday point "Free AI lessons" at ka-performancefl.com/training/ai. That page is lessons for building with AI coding tools (Codex, first build orientation), not everyday business use like writing emails or planning a week. Options: keep /training/ai; switch to /ai-launch/ (the 90-Day AI Launch page for business owners, but it is a paid program, so the wording would change from "free lessons" to something like "how we set up AI in a business"); or add a beginner lesson to /training/ai later. Thursday is already a Metricool draft; switching means I update its caption.

title: Connect the K&A LinkedIn company page to Metricool
detail: The eight LinkedIn posts go on the K&A company page and you repost them from your profile. In Metricool: Brand settings > Connect LinkedIn > choose the K&A company page (not your personal profile). Until it is connected, nothing can be scheduled there. Paste the company page URL here too.

title: Tonight's posts: schedule live or as drafts?
detail: Tonight's carousel (6:30 PM) and LinkedIn post (7:00 PM) go out today. As drafts you would need to preview and promote them in Metricool before they post. Live means approving here is the last step.
